scope: Define and evaluate a separately versioned AM 12.2 successor under a q95-excluding study domain; retain generic-q custody as unresolved nonblocking provenance and do not implement, adopt, or re-audit Citlali.

decision_paths.description: Define and evaluate the copied AM 12.2 payload under an explicit profile, grid, spectral, warning, validation, and q95-excluding study-domain policy as a separately versioned successor model. P1 narrows post-hoc profile/H2O-scale recipes but selects no profile rule, and independent physical intermediate-profile evidence is still required.
decision_paths.historical_custody_effect: The generic-q custody gap, including missing original q95 bytes and historical generator association, remains explicitly unresolved and nonblocking; the successor does not replace or reproduce the historical generic products. Study selection does not authorize an operator or operational domain.

custody_constraints: Supply files locally with SHA-256 provenance; Codex must not access Unity.
Do not substitute a contemporary am release, current LMT site defaults, synthetic profiles, or guessed bandpass weights for the historical inputs.
Do not fetch the recorded TolTECA HTTP endpoint as part of this package; an owner or data custodian must stage the intended bytes.

required_items.request: Optionally stage the original am_q95 raw NPZ bytes registered by TolTECA as datafile ID 461 for historical closure. For the selected successor evaluation, retain Q95-001 as unresolved_retained and diagnostic-only rather than substituting a copied annual or seasonal product.
acceptance: MD5 exactly equals 0ca7b331823237767d26016d19bffb3d.
NPZ members and shapes are inventoried without rewriting the file.
The 225-GHz/80-degree transmission is compared with the repair-base q95 literal 0.7337698; any mismatch is reported rather than normalized.

required_items.request: Establish by custody evidence whether the copied AM 12.2 payload generated the separate generic q25/q50/q75/q95 registry products, or supply the alternative exact generator payload with SHA-256 identity. The copied payload itself is already fully inventoried and must not be supplied again.
acceptance: The generator-to-generic-product relationship is tied to a run record, producer record, immutable archive, or equivalent custody evidence rather than numerical similarity alone.
Any alternative executable/source, patch, build option, and dependency identity is SHA-256 bound.

required_items.request: Supply the exact generic-q raw-grid argv/configuration, profile-to-q mapping, H2O scale, environment, and parser/packer, or identify the exact producer record that maps those facts onto the copied AM 12.2 workflow. Only the generic-q recipe is missing; the copied annual/seasonal argv and packer are recovered.
acceptance: Every referenced generic-q input is staged or immutable-addressed and SHA-256 identified.
The record explains the generic 31-elevation products versus the copied 36-elevation products and declares frequency output, slant paths, units, precision, H2O scale, and NPZ packing order.

required_items.request: Select the exact profile/config family and H2O-scale rule for the separately versioned copied-AM-12.2 successor. Do not resupply the 25 copied AMC files; their bytes and provenance are already inventoried.
acceptance: For a successor, the owner explicitly selects annual, seasonal, season-aware, or another stated rule and records it as a new model version.

required_items.request: Approve the copied suite's documented MERRA-2 construction as the basis of a separately versioned successor and specify how intermediate-opacity profiles will be constructed across the q95-excluding study range.
acceptance: The new successor rule is reproducible from immutable or digest-identified inputs.
The physical meaning of q25/q50/q75 and intermediate nodes is explicit and is not inferred solely by scaling a fitted transmission surface.

required_items.request: Approve the copied explicit pressure-layer, plane-parallel/no-refraction convention for the successor and state whether altitude/datum metadata is required as model identity.
acceptance: The copied convention is explicitly approved as the versioned successor convention.
The raw-generator slant geometry is kept distinct from Citlali's downstream modified-secant sample-airmass formula.

required_items.request: Choose whether the complete warning-status AM 12.2 10-MHz grid is retained for the successor or a finer-grid run policy is required; the 1-MHz convergence diagnostic is already available. Freeze the successor elevation-selection and packing rule.
acceptance: The successor rule fixes array names, shapes, coordinate ordering, and units without post hoc resampling.
The grid discrepancy and any operational treatment of AM's unresolved-line status 1 are resolved explicitly rather than silently normalized.

required_items.request: Provide independent atmosphere-model calculations at preregistered intermediate zenith tau225 nodes 6.94133915289252557e-02 and 1.23326285582665493e-01, or approve a different blinded q95-excluding holdout design before generation. Supply the physical profile-construction rule for each node rather than scaling a fitted transmission surface.
acceptance: Runs cover the full proposed operational elevation and spectral grid.
Candidate fitting does not consume the held-out outputs before the operator definitions and error metric are frozen.
At least one independent run lies in each q25--q50 and q50--q75 interval.

required_items.request: Choose whether the successor uses the recovered legacy monochromatic convention or intentionally changes to a band-integrated operator. Record the choice as a versioned scientific convention.
acceptance: A monochromatic choice fixes 272.73, 214.29, and 150.00 GHz with 225.00 GHz as the reference.
A band-integrated choice is labeled a new model version and triggers BAND-001-CONDITIONAL.

required_items.request: If SPEC-001 selects band integration, identify exact passband arrays and SHA-256 values, array/detector aggregation, normalization, source spectral weighting convention and reference spectrum, interpolation/quadrature rule, out-of-band handling, and the definition of the band/reference transmission ratio.
acceptance: All three bandpasses and their generator/release are immutable and versioned.
Integration reproduces a frozen reference table in an independent rerun.

required_items.request: Approve exact zenith-tau225 and aligned-elevation endpoints after the q95-excluding successor study. Q95 conditions are excluded, the present 30--80 degree analysis is diagnostic only, and no extrapolation is authorized.
acceptance: Minimum and maximum values, endpoint inclusivity, out-of-domain fail-closed behavior, and aligned-sample identity/timing/interpolation/duration/original-versus-synthesized eligibility rules are explicit.
The domain is contained in the supplied raw and held-out model support.

facts_already_recovered_do_not_request_a: Complete q25/q50/q75 NPZ grids and their SHA-256/registry MD5 identities.
Raw grid coordinates: 0--500 GHz at 0.01 GHz and 20--80 degrees at 2 degrees.
Legacy nominal samples: 272.73, 214.29, 150.00, and reference 225.00 GHz.
Legacy fit: numpy.polyfit degree six in elevation radians over 31 nodes, coefficient rounding to eight decimals, and no passband integration.
Selector zenith-tau225 anchors derived as -log(T225 at 80 degrees)/X(80 degrees); q25/q50/q75 are verified against raw bytes.

Complete copied AM 12.2 source/build payload, co-staged Linux executable, exact 900-command argv workflow, NPZ packer, 25 AMC profiles, 900 DAT outputs, and 25 NPZ products with SHA-256 provenance. The executable's version/build identity matches the copied output headers, and co-staging is suite-custody evidence that the ELF accompanied this local payload; no producer record proves that this exact ELF generated the historical files or connects it to the generic q products.

Copied-profile metadata: LMT latitude/longitude comments, MERRA-2 inst3_3d_asm_Np v5.12.4, 2007--2016 interval, per-pressure-level H2O percentile, median O3, explicit layers, plane-parallel/no-refraction realization, and unit H2O scale.
All 20 copied seasonal NPZs exactly match their TolTECA seasonal registry records; five annual products have no generic registry identity and none may be substituted for generic q95 ID 461.
All 900 copied DAT files exactly match their NPZ f/tau/tx/Trj fields; all are numerically complete but retain unresolved-line warning and Slurm exit-status-1 provenance.

A distinct GCC-15 native AM 12.2 build exactly reproduces all five parsed fields and numeric data lines for the full 180-case annual matrix. The canonical run binds an immutable runner/host/locale/build/source/profile/reference execution context into every sidecar, uses a whole-cache POSIX writer lock and ordered per-phase shards, and has zero cache-mutation warnings, zero unknown warnings, and zero error lines. All cases retain the accepted unresolved-line warning and status 1; this is not a clean software-success claim. Two weaker predecessor attempts are explicitly excluded or superseded.

The SHA-256-bound 10/5/2/1-MHz center-frequency study passes its 0.1% numerical-resolution diagnostic. All 16 argv/input/output identities and warning classes are retained; unresolved-line status persists and no operational warning policy is inferred.

Post-hoc P1 directly ran all 100 copied-profile/fitted-H2O-scale hypotheses after matching all 100 parsed 225-GHz/elevation-80 anchors. Frozen rank-one recipes are q25 transmission LMT_MAM_5 scale 1.81225445269332575e+00 and Rayleigh-Jeans LMT_DJF_5 scale 3.01439309124786581e+00; q50 transmission LMT_MAM_25 scale 9.15696647246186712e-01 and Rayleigh-Jeans LMT_DJF_25 scale 2.02963214820032256e+00; q75 transmission LMT_DJF_50 scale 1.88602893644962655e+00 and Rayleigh-Jeans LMT_DJF_75 scale 1.01048455031671569e+00; q95 combined-ratio RMS LMT_DJF_25 scale 6.88363302058917359e+00. No q25/q50/q75 full-grid hypothesis passes 1%; all 225 nominal direct rows pass with worst error 6.65829283961727556e-03. Q95 results remain historical diagnostics. P1 narrows recipes but does not close successor study-definition or validation facts.
